_doc: D3d (MIGRATION-PLAN §3r): the Processed Purge copy. Eight data nodes change; the three multi-item writes batch `independently` (Q18). The daily schedule stays; a declared temporary webhook trigger (Q13) feeds Load Config for drills and is removed before any swap (D3e).
name: MIG COPY — Processed Purge

Delete Old Processed.query: DELETE FROM salon.processed_messages WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, true AS deleted

Find Stale Conversations.query: SELECT @@shape(conversations)@@ FROM salon.conversations WHERE recent_messages <> '' AND last_updated < $1::timestamptz

Scrub Recent Messages.query: UPDATE salon.conversations SET recent_messages = '' WHERE id = $1 RETURNING @@shape(conversations)@@

Delete Old Leads.query: DELETE FROM salon.leads WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, true AS deleted
